national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Meets Russian President Vladimir Putin at 26th SCO Summit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi held bilateral talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin on the sidelines of the 26th annual Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit in Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan.
The leaders reviewed cooperation in trade, investment, energy, and defence under their special and privileged strategic partnership.
PM Modi reiterated India's stance on a peaceful resolution to the Ukraine conflict, emphasizing the transition from endless wars to ending wars ahead of the India-hosted BRICS Summit.

national_news.title: IIT Jammu and NHAI Showcase Key Indigenous Tech and Infrastructure Projects
bullets: IIT Jammu highlighted indigenous innovations including 'Litter Vision', an AI and IoT-enabled system utilizing UAV surveillance to manage plastic waste along fragile Himalayan corridors like the Amarnath Yatra route.
Researchers at IIT Jammu's IC-ResQ Lab demonstrated the indigenous 'iPACE-CHIP' pacemaker chip being developed under the central Chips to Start-up (C2S) Programme.

NHAI reported progress on the Kathua-Katra section of the Delhi-Amritsar-Katra Expressway targeting completion by November 2027, alongside plans for a parallel tube at the Syama Prasad Mookerjee Chenani-Nashri Tunnel.

national_news.title: President Addresses Convocation of National Institute of Fashion Technology
bullets: President Droupadi Murmu addressed the convocation ceremony of the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), highlighting the textile sector's critical role in preserving cultural heritage and generating employment.
Emphasized significant female representation in the fashion and design sector, noting that women accounted for nearly 85% of the graduating students.
Urged students to connect India's traditional craft heritage with global contemporary markets to contribute towards the vision of Viksit Bharat by 2047.

national_news.title: Government Notifies Semicon 2.0 Scheme with Rs 1.27 Lakh Crore Outlay
bullets: Union Minister for Electronics and Information Technology Ashwini Vaishnaw notified the Semicon 2.0 scheme with an outlay of Rs 1.27 lakh crore across six pillars.
The program aims to embed India deeply into the global semiconductor value chain, spanning from wafer fabrication to end-to-end chip production.
India projects capturing nearly 10% of the global semiconductor market share through sustained policy support, talent development, and ecosystem expansion.

national_news.title: Indian Rescue Teams Assist Nepal Following Devastating Avalanche and Flash Floods
bullets: A massive ice-rock avalanche at 5,200 metres in Rasuwa's Langtang-Lirung area triggered severe flash floods along the Lhende, Bhotekoshi, and Trishuli rivers in Nepal and Tibet.
The disaster severely impacted multiple hydropower infrastructure sites, including Trishuli-3A, Chilime, and Langtang projects.
India deployed a specialized tunnel rescue team to collaborate with the Nepali Army for search, rescue, and debris-clearing operations.

national_news.title: 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit to be Held in Gandhinagar
bullets: The 11th Vibrant Gujarat Global Summit will take place from 10th to 12th January in Gandhinagar under the theme 'Viksit Gujarat – Shaping Global Future'.
First conceptualised in 2003, the biennial summit has evolved into a global platform for business networking, strategic partnerships, and investments.
The upcoming summit focuses on green hydrogen, green energy, semiconductors, technology, agriculture, and food processing sectors.

national_news.title: DoT and Himachal Pradesh Partner to Accelerate National Broadband Mission 2.0
bullets: The Department of Telecommunications (DoT) partnered with the Himachal Pradesh government to speed up implementation of National Broadband Mission (NBM) 2.0 and Digital Bharat Nidhi (DBN)-funded projects.
NBM 2.0 focuses on extending Optical Fibre Cable (OFC) network and high-speed broadband to rural, hilly, border, and unserved areas.
The mission aims to ensure last-mile digital connectivity to primary health centers, schools, Anganwadi centers, and Gram Panchayat offices.

national_news.title: India and Brazil Hold 8th Trade Monitoring Mechanism Meeting in Brasilia
bullets: Commerce Secretary Rajesh Agrawal co-chaired the 8th India-Brazil Trade Monitoring Mechanism (TMM) meeting in Brasilia alongside Brazil's Tatiana Lacerda Prazeres.
Both nations reaffirmed their target to scale bilateral trade to USD 30 billion by 2030, following a trade volume of USD 15.07 billion in 2025-26.
Key focus areas included expanding the India-MERCOSUR Preferential Trade Agreement and easing pharmaceutical market access leveraging the CDSCO-ANVISA MoU signed in February 2026.

national_news.title: Consumer Affairs Ministry Notifies Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026
bullets: The Department of Consumer Affairs notified the Legal Metrology (Indian Standard Time) Rules, 2026, mandating IST as the common standard time reference across official, commercial, and digital systems nationwide after a 180-day transition period.

The policy encourages the use of NavIC (India's satellite navigation system) and local time dissemination infrastructure to reduce dependency on foreign satellite time sources across critical sectors like banking, telecom, and power grids.

Under the 'One Nation, One Time' initiative, a White Rabbit Technology-based IST Dissemination Demonstration Network was commissioned at RRSL Bengaluru to ensure precise and secure time synchronization.

national_news.title: India and Uzbekistan Elevate Relations to Comprehensive Strategic Partnership
bullets: India and Uzbekistan elevated their bilateral ties to a Comprehensive Strategic Partnership and established a framework for the long-term supply of uranium and rare earth mineral mining.
Prime Minister Narendra Modi was conferred with Uzbekistan's highest honor for foreign leaders, the 'Oliy Darajali Do’stlik' Order (Order of Friendship of the Highest Degree).

Both nations set a bilateral trade target of $5 billion by 2030 and agreed on MoUs covering Ayurveda, tourism, digital public infrastructure, and the restoration of Buddhist sites Fayaz Tepa and Kara Tepa.

bihar_news.title: Proposed High-Speed Bullet Train Corridor to Connect Delhi, UP, and Bihar
bullets: Union Railway Minister Ashwani Vaishnaw announced a proposed high-speed rail corridor connecting Delhi to major cities in Uttar Pradesh and Bihar, including Agra, Kanpur, Lucknow, Varanasi, and Patna.
The 1,170 km Delhi-Patna bullet train corridor is expected to reduce travel time between the national capital and Patna to 4.5 hours, and Delhi to Varanasi (945 km) to 3 hours 33 minutes.
This planned project represents the next phase of high-speed rail development after the 350 kmph design-speed Mumbai-Ahmedabad High Speed Rail (MAHSR) corridor.

bihar_news.title: Bihar and Jharkhand Sign Historic MoU to Resolve 25-Year Sone River Water Dispute
bullets: A Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) was signed between Bihar and Jharkhand in the presence of Union Home Minister Amit Shah to permanently resolve the 25-year-old Sone River water-sharing dispute.

The pact ensures reliable drinking and irrigation water access across eight districts in Bihar (Bhojpur, Buxar, Rohtas, Kaimur, Aurangabad, Arwal, Gaya, and Patna) and key districts in Jharkhand like Palamu and Garhwa.
The dispute stemmed from the unapportioned 7.75 million-acre-feet (MAF) water share allocated to undivided Bihar under the 1973 tripartite Bansagar Accord following Jharkhand's creation in 2000.

bihar_news.title: SJVN Completes Trial Run of 660 MW Unit-2 at Buxar Thermal Power Project
bullets: SJVN Limited completed the 72-hour trial run of the 660 MW Unit-2 of its 1,320 MW Buxar Thermal Power Project in Bihar, moving it toward commercial operation.
The project is being constructed by SJVN Thermal Private Limited using supercritical technology for enhanced energy efficiency and lower environmental impact.
Once fully commissioned, both 660 MW units of the Buxar plant are expected to generate about 9,828.72 million units of electricity annually.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Govt to Launch 'Shikshak Samadhan Portal' for Teacher Grievance Redressal
bullets: The Bihar Education Department will launch the 'Shikshak Samadhan Portal' on September 5, 2026 (Teachers' Day) in Patna.
The portal acts as a single-window platform designed to address and resolve all teachers' grievances within a mandatory 30-day period.
Failure to resolve grievances within 30 days will trigger official inquiries against accountable departmental officers.

bihar_news.title: Water Release from Valmiki Nagar Barrage Inundates Parts of West Champaran
bullets: Around 180,000 cusecs of water was discharged from the Valmiki Nagar Gandak Barrage in West Champaran district following heavy rainfall and flooding in neighbouring Nepal.
The rising water levels of the Gandak River submerged critical transport routes connecting several villages in the Bagaha-2 block situated near the Valmiki Tiger Reserve.
As a precautionary safety measure, the Bihar district administration shifted more than 5,000 residents from low-lying vulnerable areas to safer locations.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces All-Women Mahila Vishwavidyalaya and Financial Support Schemes
bullets: Bihar announced plans for a proposed Mahila Vishwavidyalaya where all academic, administrative, faculty, and leadership positions (including Vice-Chancellor) will be reserved exclusively for women.

The state government disbursed approximately ₹600 crore via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) to nearly 5 lakh beneficiaries under the Mukhyamantri Mahila Rojgar Yojana and outlined a target to spend ₹20,000 crore by 2030 for JEEViKA Didis.

The announcements were made during the launch of the Samriddh Mahila Samriddh Bihar Abhiyan in Patna, alongside an MoU signed with Prajapita Brahma Kumari Ishwariya Vishwavidyalaya for anti-addiction awareness.
